title: Weekend plans
prompts: What did you do last weekend?
What are your plans for this weekend?
If you had a free Saturday, how would you spend it?
tips: 试着用过去时和将来时（going to / will）。

title: Food & cooking
prompts: What's your favorite dish and why?
Can you describe how to make a simple meal?
Have you ever tried cooking something new?
tips: 练习描述步骤：first, then, after that, finally。

title: Learning English together
prompts: What study habits work best for you?
Which skill is hardest right now — speaking, writing, or listening?
How can we help each other stay consistent this month?
tips: 多用 I find it hard to… / One thing that helps me is…

title: Travel dreams
prompts: If you could visit any city next year, where would you go?
What's more important on a trip: food, people, or scenery?
Tell a short story about a memorable trip (real or imagined).
tips: 练习条件句：If I could… / I would…
